risk_note: RV2 by path (the PR carries rule tests). Admin REST data provider for /admin/v1 (unwrap {code,msg,data}, page / page_size up to 200, Bearer and X-Step-Up-Token only to same-origin /admin/v1, no redirects, unified error object and one onError call, 42901 Retry-After with a 5 s default, local error codes -1 to -4 with admin_api.* keys) and access control (pending-sync constant removed now that CT-21a is merged, permissionsFromMe, exact-match CASL, stepUpTier with per-operation exceptions per the CT-02f contract); App wires both providers. Rule tests by Codex (red first in the container), implementation by Opus 5.5 (two rounds). Written by hand.
